KR-R02.decision: measured the hot spot instead of guessing. Code fact: the graph cache looked up freshness with (len, mtime, content_sha256), and the hash can only be computed after reading the whole file -- so a warm cache saved parsing but not I/O. Measured on this repo, two consecutive graph builds in one ACP session: hash path cold 3279ms / warm 1217ms; with the opt-in (len, mtime) fast path cold 3296ms / warm 891ms. So reading+hashing the unchanged files was 326ms of a 1217ms warm build (27%), and skipping it is the fix. Implementation: RepoGraphCache::get_by_stat, WorkspaceCap::with_graph_stat_cache, KROMA_GRAPH_STAT_CACHE=1. Default stays on the content-hash path because trusting mtime is a correctness trade-off, not a free win. No regression: full suite 1312 passed / 0 failed.
